Overview
In this final chapter of the book we 
look at globalisation, something 
that has been referred to in 
many chapters of this book and 
textbooks of many other subjects. 
We begin by analysing the concept 
of globalisation and then examine 
its causes. We then discuss at 
length the political, economic 
and cultural consequences of 
globalisation. Our interest is also in

We then discuss at length the political, economic and cultural consequences of globalisation.
Our interest is also in studying the impact of globalisation on India as well as how India is affecting globalisation.

She now has an opportunity to take on a job and begin an independent career, which the women of her family had never dreamt of earlier.

All three examples illustrate an aspect each of what we call globalisation.
